rows: Severe thunderstorm winds blew down several trees in Batesville.
Resident on the Double Dime Ranch reported nickel size hail.
Ping pong ball size hail at the HEB grocery store.
A thunderstorm produced wind gusts estimated at 61 knots along with penny to nickel size hail.
The Zavala County Emergency Manager reported wind damage to several trees and mobile homes on the east side of La Pryor.
A thunderstorm produced wind gusts estimated at 60 mph north of Big Wells.
Media video depicted wind damage to trees, powerlines, roofs, and irrigation equipment in and near the town of Batesville. Time is estimated from radar.
A thunderstorm produced wind gusts estimated at 68 mph.
